studiesSync.title: Studies Sync
studiesSync.subtitle: Automatic import from ClinicalTrials.gov and CTIS, with translation into the mobile app languages.
studiesSync.conditionsHint: Free text passed to CTgov / CTIS. Example: "Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis".
studiesSync.targetLanguagesHint: EN is the source and always available. These languages are generated on top.
studiesSync.cronHint: Default: 0 3 * * * — daily at 03:00 UTC. Changes apply after the next container restart.
studiesSync.historyHint: The list auto-refreshes every 10 seconds. Legend: ↑ new/changed, = unchanged, ∑ total found.
studiesSync.runStartedMessage: The sync is running in the background.
studiesSync.translationBackfillHint: Checks all existing studies and adds translations for languages that are still missing. No CTgov/CTIS traffic, only LLM calls for genuinely missing translations.
studiesSync.backfillStartedMessage: Missing translations are being added in the background. Progress is written to the log; new texts appear on the studies as they complete.
studiesSync.backfillPromptBody: Translation settings changed. Existing studies do not currently have all configured languages — the next nightly sync only covers new/changed studies. Should the backfill run now?
studiesSync.backfillPromptCost: Runs in the background. Cost only for genuinely missing translations — already translated languages are skipped.
studiesSync.fullScanStartedMessage: The sync runs in the background and ignores the delta filter — all trials are re-evaluated.
studiesSync.fullScanPromptBody: A source (ClinicalTrials.gov or CTIS) was reactivated. The next nightly sync would only pick up trials changed since the last success — trials added during the off-time would be missed. Start a full sync now that ignores the delta filter?
studiesSync.fullScanPromptHint: Runs ~25 minutes and re-fetches all trials from the active registers. Hash dedup prevents unnecessary overwrites — costs fall only for trials that actually changed.
studiesSync.resetHint: Deletes ALL studies from Medplum, clears the exclusion list, and resets the sync timestamps. The next sync run reloads everything from CTgov and CTIS. Cannot be undone.
studiesSync.resetConfirmWarning: This will delete ALL studies from Medplum, clear the exclusion list, and reset the sync timestamps. This cannot be undone.
studiesSync.resetDoneMessage: {{studies}} studies deleted, {{excludes}} excludes cleared. Sync timestamps reset.
studiesSync.resetSyncRunning: A sync run is currently active. Please wait.
